notes.title: Mobile Launch | Steam Events (Wholesome Games, Back to School) | AnimeNYC
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Got some big announcements for the coming weeks.

Mobile Launch
First and foremost, Ouros is out now on iOS and Android! I've been working hard to make Ouros play wonderfully on mobile devices, and can't wait for you to give it a try!


 Buy it on iOS here
 Buy it on Android here


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/0e311288105403d9db573c633abd26ed31686a8b.png

Wholesome Games Steam Celebration Event

Ouros will be on sale for the Wholesome Game Steam Celebration from August 15th to 21st. Check it out, as well as all the other wholesome games part of the event!

Click here for the Wholesome Games Steam Event. The event starts on August 15th, 1pm ET.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/874139cf321e0b14ec819f24bb1a6df5d2e8eb1a.png

PlayNYC x AnimeNYC

I'll also be﻿ exhibiting Ouros at PlayNYC from August 23rd to 25th. This year, PlayNYC is partnering with AnimeNYC to host the event. If you are in NYC and attending this convention, say hello and check out my booth!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/9b0e8374b6ec4fb7a7820a4548c161685d3a8af2.png

Back to School Games Celebration - Steam Event

Lastly, Ouros will be on sale for the Back to School Games Celebration on Steam from August 26th to September 1st! Expect some games that are educational, productivity-enhancing, and help enrich your mind!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/bca1d49df623d10e265c604b066e0a89070035a1.png

---

That's all for now! I'm super excited for all of these events, thank you so much to everyone for all the support!

Best,
Michael

notes.title: Ouros is launching August 14th on iOS and Android
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Ouros is coming to iOS and Android on Wednesday, August 14th! 

 Pre-order for iOS here
 Pre-register for Android here

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44369464/0e311288105403d9db573c633abd26ed31686a8b.png

Ouros is a calming puzzle game about forming beautiful curves in a serene space. Find your flow as you nudge, bend, and stretch curves in﻿﻿to pleasing shapes, and discover the inherent mathematical beauty of Ouros.

Ouros plays wonderfully on mobile devices! It has multi-touch controls that feel incredibly intuitive. I've been working hard on making Ouros work on these platforms and can't wait to get this version into your hands—literally!

Cheers,
Michael

notes.content:

Known Issues

notes.title: 2024-05-29 - Touchscreen support for Windows & Linux + Other Changes & Fixes
notes.content:
Features
- Ouros should now support touchscreen for Windows devices such as the Microsoft Surface and the ROG Ally.
- Ouros also supports touchscreen on Linux. It was already supported on Steam Deck, you can use touch there too!
- Increased touch radius for control points
- updated unity version (2022.3.30f1)
- Pause Button shown in Level Selector

Bug Fixes
- Handle Empty Save File Bug
- "Flip Direction" sound now respects volume settings

Known Issues
- macOS sometimes crashes on launch (close and relaunch again if this happens)

notes.title: macOS (Intel-based) Fix
notes.content:
- removed bug that broke Intel-based macOS builds (introduced from previous patch ːsteamfacepalmː)

Current Known Issues
- macOS sometimes crashes on launch (close and relaunch again if this happens)
- flip sound effect doesn't respond to volume sliders.
